title: IMMUNIC, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Immunic, Inc. (Nasdaq: IMUX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 8-K announcing the completion of a 1-for-10 reverse stock split effective April 22, 2026. The reverse split reduces the company's outstanding shares from approximately 136 million to approximately 13.6 million, with post-split trading expected to begin on April 27, 2026.
key_points: Reverse stock split executed at 1-for-10 ratio, approved by stockholders on April 14, 2026
Outstanding shares reduced from approximately 136 million to approximately 13.6 million shares
Post-split trading begins April 27, 2026 on Nasdaq Capital Market under existing symbol IMUX
No change to authorized share count or par value
Outstanding stock options, RSUs, and warrants will have proportionate adjustments to exercise price and share quantities
Fractional shares will be aggregated and sold on the open market with proceeds distributed to affected stockholders
